Garlic Snow Peas
By: Kevin Tu
Published: Friday, December 10, 2010 - 1:02am

Ingredients




2 tablespoons Peanut oil
2 Garlic cloves
Snow peas
1/4 cup Soy sauce
1/2 cup Bean sprouts

Preparation

1 Directions: Heat the peanut oil in a wok and add the garlic cloves. Sautee to exude flavor. Remove the garlic and add the snow peas. Sautee briefly and add the soy sauce. Reduce briefly. Add the bean sprouts and toss to combine. Serve hot with Miso Chicken.
